# Veilkit — Complete Loading & Skeleton UI Toolkit

> Every loading state, beautifully. One package, every framework. Zero runtime dependencies.
> Website: https://veilkit.tashanto.com
> GitHub: https://github.com/iamtashanto/veilkit
> npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/veilkit

## Overview
Veilkit is a production-grade, zero-dependency universal loading and skeleton UI toolkit for React, Next.js (App & Pages Router), Vue 3, Nuxt 3, Svelte 4/5, Angular 17-19, Web Components, React Native/Expo, and Vanilla HTML/CDN.

### Key Capabilities
- **Zero Runtime Dependencies**: Core has 0 dependencies. Frameworks are optional peer dependencies.
- **Pure GPU Compositor Motion**: Strictly uses `transform` and `opacity` properties. Eliminates browser layout thrashing and ensures 60 FPS animation without battery drain.
- **Synchronized Global Timeline**: All shimmers across the page share a synchronized clock phase using negative CSS animation-delay derived from `performance.now() % duration`. Zero phase jitter.
- **Anti-Flicker Timing**: Built-in delay (default 150ms) prevents micro-flashes on fast API responses; minVisible (default 300ms) guarantees clean transitions.
- **45+ Presets**: Ready-made responsive layouts for product cards, dashboards, feeds, articles, chat, checkouts, forms, music players, tables, and trees.
- **5 Shape Styles**: rounded (8px), pill (9999px), square (4px), sharp (0px), glass (frosted blur 12px + border).
- **30 GPU Animations**: shimmer, wave, pulse, blink, breathe, glass-shine, gradient-flow, aurora, scan-line, sparkle, neon-glow, stagger, ripple, ping-pong, wipe, cascade, spotlight, rainbow, heartbeat, liquid, stripes, halftone, border-glow, typewriter, glitch, pixelate, tilt, diagonal-sweep, bounce-in, fade-slide.
- **30 Spinners**: CSS/SVG scalable spinners with glass variants and custom speed.
- **16 Loading Button Styles**: Stateful machine (idle -> loading -> success | error -> idle), promise tracking, double-click protection, zero layout shift, animated checkmark/cross, ripple/scale press feedback, and native expo-haptics.
- **Custom Skeleton Builder**: Fluent builder API (`new SkeletonBuilder()`) and declarative config (`createCustomSkeleton(config)`) to create custom skeletons matching any layout.
- **DOM Auto-Measure Engine**: Wrap real UI with `<Veil loading>` or `v-veil="loading"` to automatically measure leaf elements and reveal content with fade/blur-in transitions.
- **Top Route Progress**: NProgress-style route loader with auto-trickle and error fallbacks.

## Framework Quickstarts

### 1. React & Next.js
```tsx
import { Skeleton, SkeletonPreset, LoadingButton, Spinner } from 'veilkit/react';

export default function MyComponent({ loading }) {
  if (loading) {
    return <SkeletonPreset name="product-card" shape="glass" animation="aurora" />;
  }
  return <LoadingButton onClick={async () => await saveData()}>Save</LoadingButton>;
}
```

### 2. Vue 3 & Nuxt
```vue
<script setup>
import { VSkeleton, VSkeletonPreset, VLoadingButton } from 'veilkit/vue';
</script>

<template>
  <VSkeletonPreset name="dashboard" shape="rounded" animation="shimmer" />
</template>
```

### 3. Svelte 5 / SvelteKit
```svelte
<script>
  import { presetAction } from 'veilkit/svelte';
</script>

<div use:presetAction={{ name: 'chat', shape: 'pill' }} />
```

### 4. Custom Skeleton Builder
```ts
import { SkeletonBuilder } from 'veilkit';

const skeleton = new SkeletonBuilder({ animation: 'shimmer', shape: 'rounded' })
  .card((c) => {
    c.row((r) => {
      r.avatar(48);
      r.col((col) => {
        col.heading('60%');
        col.lines(2);
      });
    });
    c.rect('100%', 140);
    c.button(120, 38);
  })
  .build();
```

## Installation
```bash
npm install veilkit
pnpm add veilkit
yarn add veilkit
bun add veilkit
```
